Common causes include `fatty liver disease, alcohol use, medications, and viral hepatitis`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF124XBtetCk8N8b4Q3wYeggFC2bMcj0r4WDTevj1cJHnSZ9ryVVibyns3l7_pW6HO_nzUGJObOvXJH7gYR9Vc7dvw81JPJQdKfPVkAdjlk7Wfmp3hYGjjJH10H0dS-UnzpaFqJ99HJ9uL5mn6amUvd4Vpj9wq131Sr9DyNa5m4rCA2V30WlniuMGr6EwUHg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1-KCiMvDm8ms1vmp3SZnqeENz9WO83AqTH2fF7LIZqwzbbuV3KIsvvRPBU4e9LaN8vjFE0yZAtNvlF5EyKhBsuff8XCH8_z_6XJvLs7hHqT-OfOzmf7qFF8cLZQp0c3Hrfp61Yy4BO_FQa3y6Z6joYGERc-wsjUBd_poFXXbCr8806gu)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1wPUjh5eD9-t_eDsjXx5f0HTqamtwSDeTx6d_-gkqxYfo-lfRhCLEb5N322_CPeldfXh4_Cwlc8bq1STp56Y53jApnYHbYg4nJqDWMMjDcoZeanq5cTwPiY3SyERmgdfwoNEuApZlp-7ZjPcoByyX_osBkcx8QZ3nwT5kuFTwTdMxeOtvRst17hHSyxx2Y6NXK5pVMHotldZb7htyCiaLFc9rWRXfI2dmqLJMJyHNQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1yoqL-V0OBY-ncUH5ngsuGNdpsRZ9rkTj9ezB-6Gj1nuwRSe63Y2mmaU5zLze8xCmaIoMQbK-YF3aXPvJ1fnclXsed6Ww-MgpMin7mK5pTI0UKQdECDVAzP_2OBsoiUjC2S4_gAa80Tk481rYvuohXHIjqzosO5lT9PusqkZ)

### Most Common Causes

- **Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD):** Excess fat buildup in the liver, often tied to higher body weight, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, high cholesterol, or high triglycerides.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1wPUjh5eD9-t_eDsjXx5f0HTqamtwSDeTx6d_-gkqxYfo-lfRhCLEb5N322_CPeldfXh4_Cwlc8bq1STp56Y53jApnYHbYg4nJqDWMMjDcoZeanq5cTwPiY3SyERmgdfwoNEuApZlp-7ZjPcoByyX_osBkcx8QZ3nwT5kuFTwTdMxeOtvRst17hHSyxx2Y6NXK5pVMHotldZb7htyCiaLFc9rWRXfI2dmqLJMJyHNQ)
- **Alcohol use:** Heavy or long-term drinking can irritate or damage liver cells and cause alcohol-related liver disease.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF1xJbfKki7E2n6EOYEFybb-gxBrMTmWhnCJzfyYimxBG0KclHleuY6OjfURWoPTrJ24blZ_ot3wE-Wn6cwKsYXx75sAA6OQv9G42QwLqG4XJMA4CQbKVoJVAxiOVyWsMUEJ89ltQgKXgUeIShsBwWQrgy-Bk6QaoX754AzjCZTPPI5u03Z1p76tZW-m7Lquvy)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1wPUjh5eD9-t_eDsjXx5f0HTqamtwSDeTx6d_-gkqxYfo-lfRhCLEb5N322_CPeldfXh4_Cwlc8bq1STp56Y53jApnYHbYg4nJqDWMMjDcoZeanq5cTwPiY3SyERmgdfwoNEuApZlp-7ZjPcoByyX_osBkcx8QZ3nwT5kuFTwTdMxeOtvRst17hHSyxx2Y6NXK5pVMHotldZb7htyCiaLFc9rWRXfI2dmqLJMJyHNQ)
- **Medications and supplements:** Over-the-counter pain relievers (especially acetaminophen), certain prescription drugs (like statins, antibiotics, or seizure medications), and herbal supplements can raise enzyme levels.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF124XBtetCk8N8b4Q3wYeggFC2bMcj0r4WDTevj1cJHnSZ9ryVVibyns3l7_pW6HO_nzUGJObOvXJH7gYR9Vc7dvw81JPJQdKfPVkAdjlk7Wfmp3hYGjjJH10H0dS-UnzpaFqJ99HJ9uL5mn6amUvd4Vpj9wq131Sr9DyNa5m4rCA2V30WlniuMGr6EwUHg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1wPUjh5eD9-t_eDsjXx5f0HTqamtwSDeTx6d_-gkqxYfo-lfRhCLEb5N322_CPeldfXh4_Cwlc8bq1STp56Y53jApnYHbYg4nJqDWMMjDcoZeanq5cTwPiY3SyERmgdfwoNEuApZlp-7ZjPcoByyX_osBkcx8QZ3nwT5kuFTwTdMxeOtvRst17hHSyxx2Y6NXK5pVMHotldZb7htyCiaLFc9rWRXfI2dmqLJMJyHNQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAIBxCJF14_vqqZwO33Y1K15zrGwDXAHKKTotx0qbmuNQ1pMwhtVlrMT_UDHDN5cym61t00TU0HL0jCD-VSDy77-46UmRIWbPF8UXNuz48IR7rxRW43D91SEXmexXYKNzj-jyyYa1xEj8u03KFM4OZNGdRVse2Ok7caZQm3BytOr7oYycckjnPV2jWu4NAWqupXHVzEwuXOLiu-94C56SMZgft4pMTtHZfQJw2O9R3bs9J8wg-391VnACzt72BOaMwXqlM3n9zm3aod3IZaL2mp_nrjpbucSdLQ1Bp-P7dbmyJ9SV5bdW9LmP4QsqgKxesA0A58yU_SE4f9ayd_mRe5NeHjXyM8BQW9Z1jMiN6yOWN7JJfk5kwgt0jcT_2pg_AI)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UVco0M7mpqs&t=59)
- **Viral hepatitis:** Infections such as hepatitis A, B, or C cause liver inflammation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF124XBtetCk8N8b4Q3wYeggFC2bMcj0r4WDTevj1cJHnSZ9ryVVibyns3l7_pW6HO_nzUGJObOvXJH7gYR9Vc7dvw81JPJQdKfPVkAdjlk7Wfmp3hYGjjJH10H0dS-UnzpaFqJ99HJ9uL5mn6amUvd4Vpj9wq131Sr9DyNa5m4rCA2V30WlniuMGr6EwUHg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF1xJbfKki7E2n6EOYEFybb-gxBrMTmWhnCJzfyYimxBG0KclHleuY6OjfURWoPTrJ24blZ_ot3wE-Wn6cwKsYXx75sAA6OQv9G42QwLqG4XJMA4CQbKVoJVAxiOVyWsMUEJ89ltQgKXgUeIShsBwWQrgy-Bk6QaoX754AzjCZTPPI5u03Z1p76tZW-m7Lquvy)

### Less Common & Underlying Conditions

- **Autoimmune and bile duct conditions:** Autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis, or primary sclerosing cholangitis.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXX4bSmwyvgkCNicHjfGmZ3P9GpHF40IZuFKymakgWQWg361aOz32db13G6lNBDF4jP23thmSFGm1taoHm2esADvNRCG4ZUUwtXnDuEtsdhWmGhEddTUw2DjsjMayhb)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAIBxCJF14_vqqZwO33Y1K15zrGwDXAHKKTotx0qbmuNQ1pMwhtVlrMT_UDHDN5cym61t00TU0HL0jCD-VSDy77-46UmRIWbPF8UXNuz48IR7rxRW43D91SEXmexXYKNzj-jyyYa1xEj8u03KFM4OZNGdRVse2Ok7caZQm3BytOr7oYycckjnPV2jWu4NAWqupXHVzEwuXOLiu-94C56SMZgft4pMTtHZfQJw2O9R3bs9J8wg-391VnACzt72BOaMwXqlM3n9zm3aod3IZaL2mp_nrjpbucSdLQ1Bp-P7dbmyJ9SV5bdW9LmP4QsqgKxesA0A58yU_SE4f9ayd_mRe5NeHjXyM8BQW9Z1jMiN6yOWN7JJfk5kwgt0jcT_2pg_AI)

- **Other infections and conditions:** Epstein-Barr virus (mononucleosis), cytomegalovirus, celiac disease, thyroid disorders, heart failure, bile duct blockages, or liver tumors.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXB8Oum3N3gUzSl4PazvbO8eGgUtbLWb9Te3pb6ogDUOVFxyD0IiAlD2OF5hQbknWVcJ6MoZrULGd5ZrZzfAX3j_4w8oLxzSOL3cOmWaHxlGuOPhRsY2RRK4IRKpxubjhARx8PT7S6q1ti)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF124XBtetCk8N8b4Q3wYeggFC2bMcj0r4WDTevj1cJHnSZ9ryVVibyns3l7_pW6HO_nzUGJObOvXJH7gYR9Vc7dvw81JPJQdKfPVkAdjlk7Wfmp3hYGjjJH10H0dS-UnzpaFqJ99HJ9uL5mn6amUvd4Vpj9wq131Sr9DyNa5m4rCA2V30WlniuMGr6EwUHg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXX4bSmwyvgkCNicHjfGmZ3P9GpHF40IZuFKymakgWQWg361aOz32db13G6lNBDF4jP23thmSFGm1taoHm2esADvNRCG4ZUUwtXnDuEtsdhWmGhEddTUw2DjsjMayhb)

### Temporary & Non-Liver Factors
Mild elevations can sometimes be short-term and resolve on their own or after addressing a trigger. items.text: Autoimmune and bile duct conditions: Autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis, or primary sclerosing cholangitis. Other infections and conditions: Epstein-Barr virus (mononucleosis), cytomegalovirus, celiac disease, thyroid disorders, heart failure, bile duct blockages, or liver tumors.
